entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex. I... I hope you can help me. I need to return something. I bought a new helmet a few weeks ago and it's just... it's not right. I really, really needed that money back for bills this month.
I understand, and I'll certainly do my best to help you with that. Can I get your name and the order number for the helmet?

Yes, it's Sarah Gable. The order number is VF77812. The box is completely unopened, I haven't even touched it since it arrived. I've been such a loyal customer, and I'd be so grateful if you could help me out.
Thank you, Sarah. Let me pull that up. Okay, I see the order for the Aero Road Helmet, delivered on November 8th. I just need to check our return policy for you.
Oh, I hope it's okay. It's just sitting there, a reminder of a bad decision. I thought the color would be different in person.
Okay, one moment... Yes, it looks like you're well within the 90-day return window. Since the box is unopened, that makes it even easier. We can definitely process this return for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Alex. You have no idea what a help this is.

Of course, Sarah. Happy to help. It's important you're satisfied with your gear, especially when it comes to something as critical as safety. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office.
I see the email! Wow, that was fast. I'll get it sent back today. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the helmet, we'll process a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been wonderful. Thanks, Alex.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
